Эхний өдөр «천천히~» гэж байсан бол 1 жилийн дараа богино долгионы зуухаа 1 секунд үлдэхэд нээдэг болчихлоо 😅
Одоо харин шинээр ирсэн найз нь «천천히~» гэж байна 😆

천천히 (чөнчөнхи) — аажуухан
빨리빨리 (ппалли ппалли) — хурдан хурдан

💡 «빨리빨리» гэдэг үгийг Солонгост үнэхээр их сонсоно — дэлгүүр, хоолны газар, бүр хүргэлт дээр ч.

alt: A needle-felt diorama story in a Korean university dormitory. Day 1: at the elevator a busy office worker inside stabs the close button before the doors even finish opening; the coral felt mascot Mongle waits outside, relaxed, saying 천천히~ (slowly) — the doors shut in its face and it just smiles: Mongolian time. 3 months later Mongle presses the call button again and again. 1 year later Mongle stares at the microwave display 0:03, 0:02, 0:01 and slams the door open at 0:01 shouting 빨리빨리! (hurry hurry), proud to have saved one second. Then the roles flip: Mongle is inside the elevator pressing close, and a newly arrived Mongolian student outside says 천천히~. Mongle remembers its first day, gasps, reopens the doors and says sorry. One year later the new student also yanks the microwave open at 0:01 shouting 빨리빨리! while Mongle laughs.
